comments.author: Winston Rowntree
comments.html: Nice one. I wanted to be batman when i was as old as 15, so he’s one up on me.

comments.author: b.patrick
comments.html: Me too. It actually led to my being arrested – but that’s a whole other story…

comments.author: Renee
comments.html: I wanted to be Superman, but I couldn’t figure out how to change my biological makeup to match that of a Kryptonian’s.

comments.author: 50mfreestyle
comments.html: B.Patrick – you rule. I love your site. I’d love to see more “Curious Ugency” and to know if you had plans for more “my boyfriend smells.” Of course, “Eat Shit and Die” is always classic.

comments.author: b.patrick
comments.html:
Aaarggh, sorry everyone. My new school schedule took over my whole life – but it’s let up now. Updates this weekend for sure and on a regular basis for a few months (at least).
@50mfreestyle: Thanks, and I do have plans for more “My Boyfriend Smells”. I underestimated how long they would take to color and so have put them aside to get other stuff out faster.
Thanks to everyone still checking in!

comments.author: Simim
comments.html: Dude, I *still* wanna be a post-apocalyptic zombie killer, or, potentially, a zombie, thereby extending my career options way past post-mortem limitations.
